title: Refusing an Unfair Business Shortcut
paragraphs: A supplier offers Dian a noticeably lower price on materials in exchange for slightly falsifying a quality report, an arrangement he suggests happens quietly between many businesses in the industry already.
The savings would clearly benefit Dian's small company, and he suspects nobody would likely ever discover the falsified detail buried within a lengthy technical document.
Still, Dian declines the offer directly, explaining that his company's reputation depends entirely on accurate reporting, regardless of what other unnamed businesses might be quietly doing elsewhere.
Months later, when a competitor's falsified reports are publicly exposed and damage their reputation severely, Dian feels grateful he chose honesty over a shortcut that had briefly tempted him.
